scope: Uncontrolled fresh processes alternate build/recipe order, with one retained/excluded warmup per build/size/recipe. Detection includes native compartment/contour work. Save, load validation and replay are measured separately. All label identities, compartment RGB/counts, strict expansion and saved replay are checked across every build and recipe. Nucleus boundaries are compared across recipes, not independently accepted as biological truth. Process peak includes fixture generation, verification and persistence. No GUI or hardware-target acceptance.
